business_summary: Sinanen Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the energy and non-energy related businesses in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Energy wholesale and retail related businesses, Energy Solutions Business, and Non-energy business segments. It provides products and services related to energy, such as LP gas and kerosene, and electricity; and solutions, including renovation and housing equipment, as well as housework and house cleaning services. The company also sells petroleum products to corporate customers that include gasoline, kerosene, diesel oil, fuel oil, lubricating oil, and LP gas; delivery services; sales support, such as kerosene home delivery; and sales support for service stations. In addition, it is involved in the development of power sources, including solar power generation; sale, maintenance, and operation of renewable energy products for individuals and corporations; electricity supply, sale, and demand management; plumbing maintenance; and rental services. Further, the company engages in the comprehensive building maintenance business, such as residential buildings and non-residential buildings maintenance, hospital and funeral home facility management; management of condominium management associations; design, construction, and maintenance of air-conditioning and floor-heating equipment; import and sale of bikes; bike retail store; share cycle business comprising bike-sharing; system business, which includes cloud-based LP gas ERP system, power CIS, account transfer payment collection service, and centralized monitoring system; and antimicrobial business, including silver-based inorganic antimicrobial agent, anti-odor and odor adsorbent, and functional additives. The company was formerly known as Sinanen Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Sinanen Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2015. Sinanen Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Sinanen Holdings Co., Ltd.는 일본 및 국제적으로 에너지 및 비에너지 관련 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 회사는 에너지 도소매 관련 사업, 에너지 솔루션 사업, 비에너지 사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. LP가스, 등유, 전기 등 에너지와 관련된 제품과 서비스를 제공합니다. 개조 및 주택 장비는 물론 가사 및 집 청소 서비스를 포함한 솔루션도 포함됩니다. 회사는 또한 휘발유, 등유, 경유, 연료유, 윤활유 및 LP 가스를 포함한 석유 제품을 기업 고객에게 판매합니다. 배달 서비스; 등유 택배 등 판매 지원; 주유소 영업지원 등이 있습니다. 또한 태양광 발전을 포함한 전력원 개발에도 참여하고 있습니다. 개인 및 기업을 위한 재생에너지 제품의 판매, 유지, 운영 전력공급, 판매, 수요관리; 배관 유지 관리; 그리고 렌탈 서비스. 또한, 주거용 건물 및 비주거용 건물 유지관리, 병원 및 장례식장 시설 관리 등 건물 종합 유지관리 사업을 영위하고 있습니다.
